title: Toy Sundae Sets Sold at Target Recalled by Battat Inc. Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The wooden cherries on top of the toy sundae pose a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 22,000.

title: Ensto Control Oy Recalls Toggle and Rotary Switches Due to Electric Shock Hazards
summary: When switched OFF, one electrical pole may remain energized, posing a risk of electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 19,000.

title: JCPenney Recalls Cooks Deep Fryers Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The deep fryer has a faulty heating element, which can cause it to overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 27,000.

title: Toy Airplanes, Cars, and Motorcycles Recalled by S.U. Wholesale Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The recalled toys contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 5,000.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Recalled by Urgent Gear Due to Strangulation Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Nordstrom Stores
summary: The garments have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 700.

title: Ellaroo Recalls Infant Sling Carriers Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The aluminum rings on the sling carriers can bend or break. This can cause the fabric to slip through the rings and infants to fall out of the carrier. Units: About 1,200.

title: Hamilton Beach Recalls Toasters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The toasters can remain "on" (energized) after popping up, and can ignite flammable items covering or in contact with the toaster, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 482,000.

title: Pier 1 Imports Recalls Tealight Candle Holders Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The spacing of the holes in a concentrated pattern allows the holder to heat up. This can cause the tealights to burn unexpectedly fast and with a higher flame height than normal, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 18,000.

title: Portable Air Compressors Sold Exclusively at Advance Auto Parts Stores Recalled Due to Fire and Electrical Hazards
summary: The compressor's motor can overheat and ignite the protective cover, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Also, the cover might not prevent internal components from being touched, which poses an electrical shock hazard. Units: About 64,000.

title: QVC and Tristar Recall Electric Grills Due to Fire Hazard; Consumers to Receive New Instructions
summary: Cooking oils or sprays applied to the grill's cooking plates before preheating can cause the oil to ignite and/or flare up. Cooking sprays can ignite and/or flare up if used on the grill at any time. Units: About 13,500.

title: Girls' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Rebelette International Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirt jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 4,800.

title: Infantino Recalls Infant Rattles Due to Choking Hazard
summary: The tail piece on the rattles can detach, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 20,000.

title: Kawasaki Motors Corp. U.S.A. Recalls Off-Road Motorcycles Due to Frame Failure
summary: One or more of the motorcycle's frame welds could be missing or made incorrectly allowing the frame to crack or break, posing a risk of serious injury to riders. Units: About 200.

title: LDR Industries Recalls Gas Connectors Due to Fire and Explosion Hazards
summary: The gas connectors can leak propane or natural gas, posing a fire and explosion hazard to consumers. Units: About 50,000.

title: Polaris Industries Inc. Recalls ATVs Due to Risk of Injury to Riders
summary: A retention bolt can come loose, causing the rear wheels to lock up, which poses a risk of serious injury to the rider. Units: About 11,300.

title: Boys' Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by High Energy; Children Can Strangle on Drawstrings
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring through hood, which poses a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 5,000.

title: Avon Products Recalls Plush Warming Polar Bears Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The warming pouch inside the bear can overheat and ignite when heated in a microwave oven, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 113,000.

title: Plush Rocker Toys Recalled By Tek Nek Toys Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The base of the rocker can become unstable and allow the rocker to tip forward or backward, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 122,000.

title: Educational Insights Recalls Ring Toss Games Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the yellow peg of the toy contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 130.

title: Downeast Concepts Inc. Recalls Water Bottles Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: Surface paint on the metal water bottles contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 18,000.

title: Plan Toys Inc. Recalls Toy Penguins Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The head of the penguin toy can detach, exposing connectors with sharp points, presenting a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 3,000.

title: Yamaha Motor Corporation U.S.A. Recalls Rhino Side-by-Side Vehicles Due to Risk of Brake Failure
summary: The brake caliper on the left front wheel could have been made incorrectly, resulting in brake fluid leaking. This can cause a loss of braking and control of the vehicle, posing a serious safety risk to the driver and passenger. Units: About 7,800.

title: Hobby Lobby Stores Recalls Easter Egg Containers and Spinning Egg Tops Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the toys contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 13,000.

title: Toy Puzzle Vehicle Sets Recalled Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard; Sold Exclusively by QVC
summary: Surface paints on the puzzle pieces and components contain excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 198,000.

title: Progress Lighting Recalls Ceiling-Mounted Outdoor Light Fixtures; Lights Can Fall Off Mounting and Injure Consumers
summary: A weld that affixes a mounting bracket to the ceiling pan can fail, which can cause the fixture to fall and injure nearby persons. Units: About 1,000.

title: Salton Inc. Recalls Electric Toasters Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The toaster can turn on without bread in the slots and ignite items placed on top of it, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 12,000 (This recall was first announced in Dec. 2007).

title: WarmlyYours Recalls Rug Warmers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The rug warmer's cord can come loose from the plug and cause sparks or flames, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 200.

title: Galison/Mudpuppy Recalls Wire Bound Journals and Calendars Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The paint on the metal spiral bindings of the journals contains excessive levels of lead, which violates the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 90,000.

title: MEGA Brands Recalls MagnaMan Magnetic Action Figures; Ingested Magnets Pose Aspiration and Intestinal Hazards
summary: Small magnets inside the figures can detach. Magnets found by young children can be swallowed or aspirated. If more than one magnet is swallowed, the magnets can attract each other and cause intestinal perforations or blockages, which can be fatal. Units: About 1.3 million.
